rationale: Georgi is actively hiring for a GTM Lead and runs hackathons to evangelize agentic workflow automation—while Saori brings deep materials science expertise from Resonac, a semiconductor and functional materials company. Their complementary skill sets could unlock novel applications at the intersection of materials innovation and AI-driven automation, especially if Rilo's multi-agent systems could optimize workflows in materials R&D or supply chain.
intro_message: Saori, meet Georgi—he's building AI-powered GTM automation at Rilo and is actively hiring for execution-focused roles; your materials science background at Resonac could offer interesting perspective on how agentic workflows might transform semiconductor and materials workflows.
